title: The Rapture is Coming What You Need to Know
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he delves into the mysteries of the end times, exploring the difference between the Rapture and the Second Coming of Christ. With clarity and conviction, Pastor Chris will guide you through the scriptural evidence of 2 Thessalonians 2, revealing the truth about the falling away, the man of sin, and the restrainer. Don't miss this crucial teaching that will prepare you for what's to come and give you hope in the face of uncertainty.
